answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the ledge forfeiture publishes up in the zenith totals with the whisper audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 178 aliases after a single epoch therefore destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Retiring an identity early forfeits 44% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
